document_title: Endocrine Treatment of Gender-Dysphoric/Gender-Incongruent Persons: An Endocrine Society Clinical Practice Guideline
source_notes: Endocrine Society clinical practice guideline published in 2017. The document addresses prepubertal youth, adolescents, and adults; Only in-scope monitoring recommendations applicable to adults will be included in this audit; recommendations that also apply to adolescents retain their documented adolescent-and-adult population scope rather than being converted to adult-only guidance. Geographic applicability is not explicitly stated. Two official corrigenda were identified. Corrigendum DOI 10.1210/jc.2017-02548 corrects the injectable-testosterone wording in Table 14, item 2a; the corrected wording is incorporated in REC0013 and EXT0013. Corrigendum DOI 10.1210/jc.2018-01268 corrects Recommendation 1.1 and a bone-health citation and does not alter the identified in-scope estradiol or testosterone monitoring passages. The 2017 guideline explicitly updates the Endocrine Society’s 2009 guideline; the predecessor relationship is documented, but upstream-source registration remains unresolved.

organization: World Professional Association for Transgender Health
document_title: Standards of Care for the Health of Transgender and Gender Diverse People, Version 8
source_notes: WPATH-issued open-access standards published in International Journal of Transgender Health 23(Suppl 1), S1-S259. The English publisher version is the official version and addresses a lifespan/mixed-age, internationally framed population. WPATH lists SOC8 publication as complete and currently links to this article. Publisher DOI 10.1080/26895269.2022.2125695 is a Statement of Removal explaining that an earlier correction notice referred to a previous article version published in error; extraction uses the current publisher version. No later official correction, addendum, updated hormone-therapy chapter, or supplementary monitoring material was located as of the access date. Appendix C Table 5 is explicitly adapted from the Endocrine Society Guidelines represented by SRC0001; the source-level dependency records that documented relationship without treating the entire SOC8 document as reproduced.
